text:
Morgan: hey team — quick PR for the Python quickstart streaming example. tiny wording change + a small code fix. would appreciate a quick eyeball, want to merge today if no major concerns. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428

Tara: going to take a look in ~20m. is this blocking any release?

Morgan: not blocking releases. just want the published quickstart to match the current SDK behaviour. main change: switch sample from `max_tokens` to `max_new_tokens` and show streaming with an async generator (we had a missing await in the example).

Benjamin: can you paste the snippet you changed? easier to review inline.

Morgan: sure — current in PR:```py
async def stream_example():
    resp = await client.chat.stream(",
        model=\"redwood-alpha-1\",
        prompt=\"Summarize the doc in one sentence.\",
        max_tokens=100,
    )
    async for chunk in resp:
        print(chunk.text, end=\"\")
```
Recommended fix in PR:```py
import asyncio

async def stream_example():
    resp = await client.chat.stream(
        model=\"redwood-alpha-1\",
        prompt=\"Summarize the doc in one sentence.\",
        max_new_tokens=100,
    )
    async for chunk in resp:
        print(chunk.text, end=\"\")
```

Sasha: small nits — add the `import asyncio` at top (good catch), and the `stream` returns an async iterator so callout that consumers should handle backpressure (e.g., await processing or use a buffer). otherwise readable.

devex-bot: PR checks — docs-lint: passed, link-checker: passed, snippet-smoke: failed (flaky). See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/428

Morgan: thanks — I pushed a follow-up commit to fix the snippet indentation and add a one-line callout about backpressure. commit: 3b9f7c2

Benjamin: quick read — I think we should also mention the `timeout` behavior when streaming to avoid hung processes. tiny note in docs would help.

Morgan: added a short sentence about timeouts and a sample `try/except` handle. pushed commit 3b9f7c2 -> 5a2d1e8

Tara: LGTM aside from an extra blank line in the example file. leaving a :thumbsup: on the PR once that's cleaned.

Sasha: approved. :rocket:

Benjamin: approved with comment about timeout wording (non-blocking).

Morgan: merging now. thanks everyone!

devex-bot: merged PR #428 into main by Morgan — release note queued for docs pipeline.
